name: Lutron Electronics
old_description: Manufactures lighting control switches, dimmers, and shading systems.
about:
Lutron Electronics was founded in 1961 in Coopersburg, Pennsylvania. The privately held company began as a manufacturer of lighting control devices and has since expanded into shading systems and building automation.

The company produces a range of lighting controls including dimmers, switches, keypads, remotes, and sensors, as well as motorized shades, drapery, and blinds under the Sivoia brand. Its control systems — such as HomeWorks, RadioRA3, Athena, Vive, and myRoom XC — serve residential, commercial, and hospitality projects. Lutron also offers embedded fixture technology for OEM integration. The firm provides commercial project support encompassing design and specification services, installation support, system verification, and technical startup assistance.

Lutron serves architects, builders, electrical contractors, engineers, interior designers, lighting dealers, and facility managers across residential, commercial, and hospitality sectors. Notable projects include the BlackRock headquarters, SOM offices, Hotel Indigo Dubai, Sofitel Rome, Banyan Tree Hotel, The Ritz-Carlton, Taliesin West, and the Stay Bungalow.

The company emphasizes wireless technology that enables design freedom and performance beyond traditional wired controls, along with automated glare and thermal management that preserves exterior views. Its systems integrate lighting, window treatments, and smart-home functionality into a single platform.
